proof_body:
by
  intro n f hf
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := MvPolynomial.esymmAlgHom_fin_surjective ℝ (le_refl n) (⟨f, hf⟩ : MvPolynomial.symmetricSubalgebra (Fin n) ℝ)
  refine ⟨g, ?_⟩
  have h := congrArg (MvPolynomial.symmetricSubalgebra (Fin n) ℝ).val hg
  rw [MvPolynomial.esymmAlgHom, MvPolynomial.comp_aeval_apply] at h
  exact h
target_source: ∀ (n : ℕ) (f : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ), f.IsSymmetric → ∃ g : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ, MvPolynomial.aeval (fun i : Fin n => MvPolynomial.esymm (Fin n) ℝ ((i : ℕ) + 1)) g = f
